name: Files
note: Current official reference server. Only the folder you pick is reachable — nothing else on your disk.
what: Read, write and search files in one folder you choose. The agent can work with your documents without copy-pasting.

name: Memory
note: Current official reference server. No key needed.
what: A persistent knowledge graph: the agent remembers people, projects and preferences across chats.

name: Time
note: Current official reference server. No key needed.
what: Current time and timezone conversion, so the agent stops guessing dates.

name: Thinking
note: Current official reference server. No key needed.
what: Structured step-by-step reasoning: the agent works through hard problems in explicit thought steps instead of jumping to an answer.

name: Web search
note: Brave's official successor to the archived reference search server. Needs a free Brave Search API key.
what: Real web and local search from Brave, so the agent answers with current information instead of old training data.

name: Browser
note: Microsoft's official Playwright MCP server. No key needed. First run downloads a browser once (~150MB).
what: The agent drives a real browser: open pages, read content, click, fill forms and take screenshots. You watch it work — the browser window stays visible.

name: Notion
note: Notion's official server. Needs an internal integration token (starts with ntn_) with access to the pages you want.
what: Search, read, create and update Notion pages and databases from chat.

name: GitHub
note: HONEST LABEL: this is the archived reference server — it still runs via npx, but the maintained successor is Docker-based (ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server). Use this one if you do not have Docker.
what: Repos, issues, pull requests and code search from chat.

name: Zapier
note: Remote server (Streamable HTTP). Paste your Zapier MCP connect URL from mcp.zapier.com. That URL is a credential — it lives only on your PC. Legacy /sse URLs are not supported; use the newer connect URL.
what: 9,000+ apps and 30,000+ actions as tools: Gmail, Slack, Sheets, Calendar and everything else you already connected to Zapier. You pick which actions the agent may use, at mcp.zapier.com.
